mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 73 degrees and clear by City Hall, and it will be a pleasant night with a low of 55 degrees and no rain expected.

City officials announced that the Verona Common Council has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This document is designed to guide the city's future growth and development initiatives.

There is a lot going on today, including the Dane County Farmer's Market, live music at both Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, and the Puppets in the Park festival at Century School Park. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on October 12, or trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee starting October 13.
On September 28, the Verona Police Department responded to a two-vehicle crash on CTH-PB at CTH-M, where a 71-year-old driver was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control.
Today's flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake, which is a fan favorite here in town. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
